messages.subject: When is it the project applications due?
messages.subject_clean: When is it the project applications due?
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone.
According to the status and timeline <https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2019/wiki#status-and-timeline> table today is the "Org applications due".
My project is still missing one mentor (we are waiting for response), does anyone know when this have to be completed?

thanks!

messages.body_plain:
On Wed, 2019-02-06 at 07:23 -0800, Cancu Juan Cruz Rodriguez wrote:
> Hi everyone.
> According to the status and timeline <https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2019/wiki#status-and-timeline> table today is the "Org applications due".
> My project is still missing one mentor (we are waiting for response), does anyone know when this have to be completed?
>

Toby has submitted the R Organization application. Google will consider it, as in prior years, and hopefully we will be accepted as a mentoring organization again this year.

For potential mentors and students, the R GSoC wiki is here:

https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2019/wiki

Before February 26th (as soon as possible) idea pages should be on the wiki with as much detail as you have available. These pages are where students will go to start contacting mentors and preparing their applications if R is accepted as a mentoring organization again this year.

If you have questions about proposing ideas, please feel free to reach out to me and Toby via email.

Regards,

Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/

IM: bgpbraverock
